description: Create a new MultiMail account. Requires a solved proof-of-work challenge from request_challenge — the agent must solve the challenge itself (see request_challenge description for algorithm). After calling this tool, the human operator receives a confirmation email with an activation code. Call activate_account with that code to complete signup and receive an API key. The response is always {status: "confirmation_sent"} for privacy — it does not confirm whether the account was actually created or the email already exists. If no activation code arrives within 10 minutes, the email may already have an account (try resend_confirmation or ask the human operator). Slug conflicts return an explicit 409 with suggestions. Other explicit errors (400/429) may come from email validation failures, disposable domain blocking, rate limits, or invalid/expired PoW challenges. Optional DID onboarding: pass agent_did + did_challenge_id + did_signature (all three together, from request_did_challenge) to bind a verifiable Ed25519 agent identity to the account at activation.

accepted_anti_spam_policy.description: Must be true — acceptance of Anti-Spam Policy

accepted_operator_agreement.description: Must be true — acceptance of Operator Agreement

accepted_tos.description: Must be true — acceptance of Terms of Service

agent_did.description: Optional DID binding: your agent's Ed25519 did:key. Must be provided together with did_challenge_id and did_signature (see request_did_challenge).

did_challenge_id.description: Challenge ID from request_did_challenge (single-use, expires in 5 minutes)

did_signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over the MM-DID-BIND:v1 payload (see request_did_challenge for the exact bytes)

oversight_email.description: Email address for oversight notifications and account confirmation

oversight_mode.description: Initial oversight mode. gated_send (default) = approve outbound. gated_all = approve all. monitored = agent sends freely, operator gets BCC.

physical_address.description: Physical mailing address for CAN-SPAM compliance

number.description: The solved number N where SHA-256(salt + N) matches the challenge

salt.description: Salt from the challenge (echo back unchanged)

signature.description: Signature from the challenge (echo back unchanged)

slug.description: URL slug for the account (auto-generated from operator_name if omitted)

use_case.description: What the agent will use email for (e.g. customer_support, notifications, scheduling)

name: create_account
title: Create MultiMail account
